newsitem.title: USA: Milwaukee firm bought back Mercury paper - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Milwaukee firm bought back Mercury paper - WSJ.

text.p: A Milwaukee mutual-fund-management firm bought back from its funds some Mercury Finance commercial paper to keep three of its money-market funds from falling below their desired $1 net asset value, the Wall Street Journal said Tuesday.
The paper said Strong Capital Management confirmed that it bought Mercury Finance's commercial paper from its funds, including the $2 bilion Strong Heritage Money Market Fund.
The paper said each of the three funds had about five percent of their assets invested in Mercury Finance commercial paper.
Mercury Finance last week defaulted on $17 million of commercial debt, and analysts believe the used car lender has about $100 million of debt coming due Thursday.
The company's new chief executive, William Brandt Jr, said on Monday that he hoped to receive a short-term credit facility from the company's lenders.
